# AdmitPath

> AdmitPath is a web-based college admissions planning product for high school
> students. It provides profile planning, essay feedback, college research,
> application planning, and scholarship resources. AdmitPath does not replace
> a school counselor or guarantee admission.

Canonical site: https://admith.vercel.app/
Contact: maestro.committee@gmail.com
Last reviewed: 2026-07-17

## Product facts

- The Free plan includes 5 profile analyses, 5 essay feedback runs, 5 counselor chat messages, and up to 8 saved colleges, with no time limit.
- Pro costs $19.99 per month and removes the Free-plan caps described on the pricing page.
- The current college data module contains 102 structured college records. Published figures can lag and should be verified with each institution.
- Admissions estimates are directional planning aids, not predictions or guarantees.

Sources:
- https://admith.vercel.app/pricing
- https://admith.vercel.app/methodology
- https://admith.vercel.app/privacy
